sn_aia_team.description: Food Management Intelligence analyzes campus food-service data and generates a comprehensive management report. It reviews complaints across mess halls, food items, meal types, use cases, problem types, priorities, affected students, food incidents, corrective actions, and trends. It uses available application data and AI tools to identify important patterns, recurring issues, high-risk areas, and management insights, and provides evidence-based recommendations for improving campus food services.
sn_aia_team.name: Food Management Intelligence
